instruction: Show me how to set up Thunderbird to automatically include my vCard with every outgoing email.

metadata.explanation: This task requires enabling automatic vCard attachment in Thunderbird. The evaluator uses the existing check_thunderbird_prefs function to verify that the preference 'mail.identity.id1.attach_vcard' is set to true. This is a common Thunderbird configuration task with similar complexity to the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to enable automatic vCard attachment in Thunderbird
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly fetches the Thunderbird preferences file from /home/user/.thunderbird/t5q2a5hp.default-release/prefs.js
Metric (check_thunderbird_prefs) correctly parses the prefs.js file and checks that mail.identity.id1.attach_vcard is set to true, which is the exact preference controlling automatic vCard attachment
Expected value uses correct rule-based matching to verify the preference is set to true
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird window to ensure preferences are saved to disk before verification
Complete coverage: instruction asks to enable vCard attachment, evaluator checks the specific preference that controls this feature
Metric has proper null handling (returns 0.0 if result is None) to handle file fetch failures gracefully
Static type warning is a false positive - get_vm_file returns str for single file case and metric correctly expects str with None handling

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
